outcome_sought: Reconsider the declined £8,000 debt consolidation loan in light of his pay rise.
rationale: The customer says the complaint is already with the Ombudsman and gives the reference, and the CRM shows a final response on the same decline on 15 Sep, so CP-3.5 means recording the reference and passing to Ombudsman liaison rather than starting a new investigation. His pay rise is new evidence a person must decide what to do with. He describes maxed-out cards and lost sleep, but no vulnerability note or debt advice signposting is recorded. It goes to the Ombudsman Liaison team, so only the common handover items apply.
